meta.title: Cocktail Atlas verified public-domain quotation library
meta.contentPolicy: Only documented, source-linked public-domain verse is used. No line is invented for the menu.
meta.translationPolicy: Chinese and English translations are Cocktail Atlas editorial translations unless the quoted original is already in that language.
meta.assignmentPolicy: Chinese-origin drinks use Chinese verse; all other drinks use non-Chinese verse. Origin is evidence-based and never inferred from a translated display name. Quotes may be reused when recipes share a flavour profile.

quotes.original: 花間一壺酒，獨酌無相親。

translation.zhHans: 花间一壶酒，独酌无相亲。
translation.zhHant: 花間一壺酒，獨酌無相親。
translation.en: Among the flowers, a jug of wine; I drink alone, with no one near.

translation.zhHans: 举杯邀明月，对影成三人。
translation.zhHant: 舉杯邀明月，對影成三人。
translation.en: I raise my cup and invite the bright moon; with my shadow, we become three.

translation.zhHans: 暂伴月将影，行乐须及春。
translation.zhHant: 暫伴月將影，行樂須及春。
translation.en: For now I keep company with moon and shadow; joy must be taken while spring is here.

translation.zhHans: 人生得意须尽欢，莫使金樽空对月。
translation.zhHant: 人生得意須盡歡，莫使金樽空對月。
translation.en: When life goes well, enjoy it to the full; do not let the golden cup face the moon empty.

translation.zhHans: 烹羊宰牛且为乐，会须一饮三百杯。
translation.zhHant: 烹羊宰牛且為樂，會須一飲三百杯。

translation.zhHans: 钟鼓馔玉不足贵，但愿长醉不复醒。
translation.zhHant: 鐘鼓饌玉不足貴，但願長醉不復醒。
translation.en: Bells, drums, and jade-feasts are not precious enough; I only wish to stay drunk and never wake.

translation.zhHant: 綠蟻新醅酒，紅泥小火爐。

translation.zhHant: 晚來天欲雪，能飲一杯無？

translation.zhHant: 明月幾時有？把酒問青天。
translation.en: When did the bright moon first appear? I raise my wine and ask the blue sky.

translation.en: Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence, at ease I see the southern mountain.

translation.zhHans: 秋菊有佳色，裛露掇其英。
translation.zhHant: 秋菊有佳色，裛露掇其英。
translation.en: Autumn chrysanthemums have a lovely hue; wet with dew, I pluck their blossoms.

translation.zhHant: 昨夜雨疏風驟，濃睡不消殘酒。
translation.en: Last night the rain was light and the wind fierce; deep sleep did not dispel the remaining wine.

translation.zhHans: 明月松间照，清泉石上流。

translation.zhHant: 明月別枝驚鵲，清風半夜鳴蟬。

translation.zhHant: 從一粒沙看見世界，從一朵野花看見天堂。

translation.zhHant: 我能否把你比作夏日？你卻更加可愛，也更加溫和。

translation.zhHans: 狂风摇落五月可爱的花蕾，夏日的期限又实在太短。
translation.zhHant: 狂風搖落五月可愛的花蕾，夏日的期限又實在太短。

translation.zhHant: 愛人啊，請斟滿這杯，洗淨今日對往昔的悔與來日的懼。

translation.zhHant: 我如水而來，又如風而去。

translation.zhHant: 一晚，酒的靈魂在瓶中歌唱。
translation.en: One evening, the soul of wine sang in the bottles.

quotes.original: Un chant plein de lumière et de fraternité !

translation.zhHans: 一支充满光明与友爱的歌！
translation.zhHant: 一支充滿光明與友愛的歌！
translation.en: A song full of light and fellowship!

quotes.original: Pour que de notre amour naisse la poésie / Qui jaillira vers Dieu comme une rare fleur !

translation.zhHans: 让诗从我们的爱中诞生，如一朵奇花向神明喷涌。
translation.zhHant: 讓詩從我們的愛中誕生，如一朵奇花向神明噴湧。
translation.en: So that poetry may be born of our love and spring toward God like a rare flower!

quotes.original: Voici venir les temps où vibrant sur sa tige / Chaque fleur s'évapore ainsi qu'un encensoir ;

translation.zhHans: 时辰将至，每一朵花都在茎上颤动，像香炉般蒸散。
translation.zhHant: 時辰將至，每一朵花都在莖上顫動，像香爐般蒸散。
translation.en: The hour arrives when every flower trembles on its stem and evaporates like a censer.

quotes.original: Le ciel est triste et beau comme un grand reposoir ;

translation.zhHans: 天空忧郁而美，像一座巨大的圣体台。
translation.zhHant: 天空憂鬱而美，像一座巨大的聖體臺。
translation.en: The sky is sad and beautiful like a great altar of repose.

quotes.original: Il pleure dans mon cœur / Comme il pleut sur la ville ;

translation.zhHans: 泪落在我心里，仿佛雨落在城中。
translation.zhHant: 淚落在我心裏，彷彿雨落在城中。
translation.en: It weeps in my heart as it rains upon the city.

attribution.publicDomainBasis: Author died more than 100 years ago and the cited edition was published before 1931; public domain.

quotes.original: Elle est retrouvée. / Quoi ? — L'Éternité. / C'est la mer allée / Avec le soleil.

translation.zhHans: 找到了。什么？——永恒。是大海与太阳一同远去。
translation.zhHant: 找到了。什麼？——永恆。是大海與太陽一同遠去。
translation.en: It is found again. What? Eternity. It is the sea gone away with the sun.

attribution.publicDomainBasis: Author died more than 100 years ago and the cited edition was published before 1931; public domain.

quotes.original: Cultivo una rosa blanca / En julio como en enero,

translation.zhHans: 我培育一朵白玫瑰，无论七月还是一月。
translation.zhHant: 我培育一朵白玫瑰，無論七月還是一月。
translation.en: I cultivate a white rose in July as in January.

attribution.publicDomainBasis: Author died more than 100 years ago and the cited edition was published before 1931; public domain.

quotes.original: Mi verso es de un verde claro / Y de un carmín encendido.

translation.zhHans: 我的诗是明净的绿，也是燃烧的胭脂红。
translation.zhHant: 我的詩是明淨的綠，也是燃燒的胭脂紅。
translation.en: My verse is a clear green and a blazing crimson.

attribution.publicDomainBasis: Author died more than 100 years ago and the cited edition was published before 1931; public domain.

quotes.original: Juventud, divino tesoro, / ¡ya te vas para no volver!

translation.zhHant: 青春，神聖的珍寶，你一去便不再回來！
translation.en: Youth, divine treasure, you are leaving never to return!

attribution.publicDomainBasis: The cited edition was published before 1931 and is public domain in the United States.

quotes.original: ¿Qué es poesía? ¿Y tú me lo preguntas? / Poesía... eres tú.

translation.zhHans: 什么是诗？你竟这样问我？诗……就是你。
translation.zhHant: 什麼是詩？你竟這樣問我？詩……就是你。
translation.en: What is poetry? And you ask me? Poetry... is you.
